<b>Hero's Call</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be acquired from [[Bellhart|Bellhart's]] Wishwall after either encountering [[Garmond and Zaza]] at least 3 times after entering [[Act 3]] or obtaining the [[Everbloom]].

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must follow [[Zaza]], who is calling for her in the [[Bellway]] of the [[Blasted Steps]]. He leads Hornet to a location west of the Bellway.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Lost Garmond 01.png!Lost Garmond's location in the Blasted Steps
}}

There, she finds [[Lost Garmond]], who has become possessed by the [[Void]] and must be defeated to free him and complete the Wish.

== Reward ==
[[File:Hero's Memento.png|link=Hero's Memento|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After defeating Lost Garmond, he drops the [[Hero's Memento]]. This also unlocks the [[Achievements (Silksong)|Hero's Call]] Achievement.

{{Clear}}
